business_problem: serve privacy-first advertising predictions at low latency without moving huge data volumes out of Snowflake or overpaying for inference infrastructure.
solution_summary: Yieldmo uses Snowflake, Snowpark Container Services, and Secure Data Sharing on Snowflake to serve privacy-first advertising predictions at low latency without moving huge data volumes out of snowflake or overpaying for inference infrastructure. Signals such as smartphone scrolls, tilts, and swipes from billions of daily impressions are stored and processed in Snowflake for campaign prediction workloads. Yieldmo develops models with H2O Driverless AI and runs H2O eScorer on Snowpark Container Services so inference happens next to the data instead of after large exports. The resulting predictions support near-real-time advertising decisions, while Secure Data Sharing lets Yieldmo collaborate with vendors and cybersecurity partners without building ETL pipelines. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and downstream access on one governed platform reduces data copying, simplifies operations, and gives teams a single trusted operating view for analytics and AI.
